title: Unit 2 第三课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 按照音标写出单词，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. My brother is tall and ______ /'hænsəm/.
questions.translation: 我哥哥长得又高又帅。
questions.explanation: 音标 /'hænsəm/ 对应的单词是形容词handsome（英俊的，帅气的）。故选 handsome。

questions.prompt: 2. The baby sits on his mother's ______ /niː/.
questions.translation: 婴儿坐在他妈妈的膝盖上。
questions.explanation: 音标 /niː/ 对应的单词是名词knee（膝盖），字母k不发音。故选 knee。

questions.prompt: 3. I have a new ______ /hæt/.
questions.translation: 我有一顶新帽子。
questions.explanation: 音标 /hæt/ 对应的单词是名词hat（帽子）。故选 hat。

questions.prompt: 4. My sister always wears a ______ /pɪŋk/ skirt.
questions.translation: 我妹妹总是穿一条粉红色的短裙。
questions.explanation: 音标 /pɪŋk/ 对应的单词是形容词pink（粉红色的）。故选 pink。

sections.title: 二、根据句意或汉语提示写单词
sections.instruction: 根据汉语提示与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. Every girl has a ______ (粉色的) doll (布娃娃).
questions.translation: 每个女孩都有一个粉红色的布娃娃。
questions.explanation: 形容词pink意为“粉红色的”，修饰名词doll。故选 pink。

questions.prompt: 2. He often puts his baby on his ______ (膝盖).
questions.translation: 他经常把他的小宝宝放在自己的膝盖上。
questions.explanation: 名词knee意为“膝盖”，on his knee意为“在他的膝盖上”。故选 knee。

questions.prompt:
3. —How about going ______ (远足) in the mountains?
—That sounds good.
questions.translation:
——去山里远足怎么样？
——听起来不错。
questions.explanation: go hiking为固定搭配，意为“去远足/徒步旅行”。故选 hiking。

questions.prompt: 4. We have two ______ (儿子) and a daughter.
questions.translation: 我们有两个儿子和一个女儿。
questions.explanation: 名词son意为“儿子”，基数词two后接复数名词sons。故选 sons。

questions.prompt: 5. Mary really loves her ______ (祖母). And they also love their grandmother.
questions.translation: 玛丽真的很爱她的祖母。而且他们也很爱他们的祖母。
questions.explanation: 名词grandmother意为“祖母，外祖母”，与后句中的grandmother呼应。故选 grandmother。

sections.title: 三、用方框内的词或短语填空
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择恰当的词或短语填空，每个选项只能用一次。

questions.prompt: 1. He works ______ and sleeps during the day.
questions.translation: 他在夜间工作，在白天睡觉。
questions.explanation: at night意为“在夜间”，与during the day（在白天）对应。故选 at night。

questions.prompt: 2. I want to ______ with you, but I have much work to do now.
questions.translation: 我想和你一起去远足，但我现在有很多工作要做。
questions.explanation: want to后接动词原形，go hiking意为“去远足”。故选 go hiking。

questions.prompt: 3. We often sit ______ each other.
questions.translation: 我们经常挨着彼此坐。
questions.explanation: next to为固定介词短语，意为“紧挨着，在……旁边”。故选 next to。

questions.prompt: 4. The young man looks ______. Everyone likes him very much.
questions.translation: 那个年轻男子看起来英俊帅气。大家都很喜欢他。
questions.explanation: 系动词looks后接形容词handsome（英俊的）作表语。故选 handsome。

questions.prompt: 5. My brother is standing ______ of the room.
questions.translation: 我的弟弟正站在房间中央。
questions.explanation: in the middle of为固定短语，意为“在……中间/中央”。故选 in the middle。

sections.title: 四、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.prompt: photo, my, a, of, is, here, family (.)
questions.answer: Here is a photo of my family.
questions.translation: 这里有一张我的全家福照片。
questions.explanation: 倒装句结构：“Here is” + 主语“a photo of my family”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: Tom, cousin, stands, middle, the, my, in (.)
questions.answer: My cousin Tom stands in the middle.
questions.translation: 我的堂弟汤姆站在中间。
questions.explanation: 陈述句：主语同位语结构“My cousin Tom” + 谓语“stands” + 介词短语状语“in the middle”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: think, my, grandchildren, I, loves, grandmother, really, her (.)
questions.answer: I think my grandmother really loves her grandchildren.
questions.translation: 我认为我的祖母真的很疼爱她的孙辈们。
questions.explanation: 宾语从句：主句“I think” + 从句主语“my grandmother” + 状语“really” + 谓语“loves” + 宾语“her grandchildren”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: sister, Chinese, often, chess, plays, weekends, my, on (.)
questions.answer: My sister often plays Chinese chess on weekends.
questions.translation: 我妹妹经常在周末下中国象棋。
questions.explanation: 陈述句：主语“My sister” + 频度副词“often” + 谓语动词“plays” + 宾语“Chinese chess” + 时间状语“on weekends”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: each, help, other, and, we, love (.)
questions.answer: We love and help each other.
questions.translation: 我们彼此相爱并互相帮助。
questions.explanation: 陈述句：主语“We” + 并列谓语“love and help” + 相互代词宾语“each other”，句末用句号。

sections.title: 五、句型转换
sections.instruction: 根据要求完成下列各句转换，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。

questions.prompt: 1. <u>My father's</u> favourite sport is basketball. (对画线部分提问)
options: What is your father's favourite sport?
Which sport is your father's favourite?
questions.translation:
——我父亲最喜欢的运动是篮球。（对画线部分提问）
——谁最喜欢的运动是篮球？
questions.explanation: 画线部分My father's表示所有格所属关系，对其提问疑问代词用Whose。故选 Whose favourite sport is basketball?。

questions.prompt: 2. The tall boy is my brother. (改为一般疑问句)
options: Is the tall boy your brother?
Are the tall boy your brother?
Does the tall boy your brother?
Is the tall boy my brother?
questions.translation:
——那个高个子男孩是我的哥哥。（改为一般疑问句）
——那个高个子男孩是你的哥哥吗？
questions.explanation: 含有be动词is的陈述句改为一般疑问句，将is提前到句首，my brother转换为your brother。故选 Is the tall boy your brother?。

questions.prompt: 3. My mother sits <u>next to me</u>. (对画线部分提问)
options: Who does your mother sit next to?
questions.translation:
——我的妈妈坐在我的旁边。（对画线部分提问）
——你的妈妈坐在哪里？
questions.explanation: 画线部分next to me为地点状语，对其提问疑问副词用Where；主语your mother为第三人称单数，助动词用does，谓语动词恢复原形sit。故选 Where does your mother sit?。

sections.title: 六、阅读与表达 (任务型阅读)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
As children grow up, people will come in and out of their life. But a man will always be there—their father. Then what's a father like in the eyes of his child? Let's look at some.

Song Liang is a 7th-grader from Shanxi. He has a good father. "'You are great, son.' 'I am proud of you, son.' 'You are a hard worker.' I often hear these words from my father. They let me know he loves having me as his son," says Song.

Zhang Dan, 11, is a girl from Hubei. She thinks her father is always behind her. "I like collecting coins (收集硬币). My father often takes me to coin shows. He also teaches me to learn about coins on the Internet," Zhang says. "My father loves me and he also loves my hobby (业余爱好)."

Wu Bin is a 12-year-old boy from Henan. "My father sometimes makes mistakes, but he learns from them. I see from him that it is OK to make mistakes and that mistakes can be great teachers," he says.

questions.prompt: 1. Where does Song Liang come from?
questions.translation: 宋亮来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“Song Liang is a 7th-grader from Shanxi.”可知他来自山西。故选 From Shanxi.。

questions.prompt: 2. Who likes collecting coins?
questions.translation: 谁喜欢收集硬币？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段中张丹说的话“I like collecting coins...”可知是张丹喜欢收集硬币。故选 Zhang Dan.。

questions.prompt: 3. What does Wu Bin's father do when he makes mistakes?
questions.translation: 吴斌的父亲犯错时会怎么做？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段中的“My father sometimes makes mistakes, but he learns from them.”可知他从错误中吸取教训。故选 He learns from them.。

questions.prompt: 4. What is the main idea of this passage?
options: What fathers are like in the eyes of different children.
How to collect coins on the Internet.
Why children should never make mistakes.
How to be a 7th-grader in middle school.
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章通过三位不同地区的孩子讲述各自父亲的形象，展现孩子们眼中的父亲。故选 What fathers are like in the eyes of different children.。

sections.title: 七、还原句子
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余选项。
sections.passage: The first love in life (生活) often comes from our family. We hug (拥抱) our parents, play with our brothers or sisters, or get ice-cream from our grandparents. [1] They make us feel warm and happy. Our family asks us for nothing (没有什么) for their love. Family love can make us loving and healthy children. [2] We don't have to do things to get family love. When bad things come to us, we know we have our family. [3] What do we need to do to love our family? [4] Do fun things together. Visit them often. Talk and listen to them. Give them hugs, and tell them we love them.
wordbank: The first thing is to be there with them.
Those are loving (充满爱的) times in life.
Everyone needs love in their life.
It helps us to get on with (与……和睦相处) people.
They are always there for us.

questions.translation: 那些都是生命中充满爱的美好时光。
questions.explanation: 前句列举了和家人拥抱、玩耍等温馨场景，选项B“Those are loving times in life”承接上文，符合语境。故选 B。

questions.translation: 它帮助我们与他人和睦相处。
questions.explanation: 前句讲家庭的爱使我们充满爱心并健康成长，选项D“It helps us to get on with people”进一步说明家庭之爱的积极影响。故选 D。

questions.translation: 他们永远都在我们身边支持我们。
questions.explanation: 前句提到当遇到不好的事情时我们知道有家人在，选项E“They are always there for us”说明家人始终如一的陪伴与支持。故选 E。

questions.translation: 第一件事就是陪伴在他们身边。
questions.explanation: 后文具体列举了陪伴家人的方式（一起玩乐、经常拜访等），选项A“The first thing is to be there with them”回答了“如何爱家人”的首要原则。故选 A。

sections.title: 八、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Look! This is a photo [1] my family. There are [2] people in my family. Er Shun and Qing Qing are my parents. I have two brothers. They are Jia Panpan and Yu Ke. I also have a sister and she is Jia Yueyue. We are black and white, and we look the [3]. We come from China. Every day, many people come to visit us, including (包括) men, [4], the old and the young. They like us a lot. They think we are very cute. They usually take [5] with us. We like them, too.

Every day, my brother Yu Ke and I get up at 7 o'clock, and then we [6] breakfast. Bamboo is our favourite [7]. We like to eat it every day. Our animal keepers (饲养员) are [8] to us. They often help us. I often [9] with my brother. We often climb (爬) trees and sleep in the tree. We like our zoo very much. Welcome to our [10]. I want to play with you.

questions.translation: 这是我家人的一张照片。
questions.explanation: a photo of my family为固定短语，意为“我的全家福照片”。故选 of。

questions.translation: 我的家庭有六口人。
questions.explanation: 根据后文介绍：parents（2只）、two brothers（2只）、sister（1只）加上作者自己（1只），共6只大熊猫（six）。故选 six。

questions.translation: 我们是黑白相间的，而且我们看起来一模一样。
questions.explanation: look the same为固定短语，意为“看起来一样”。故选 same。

questions.translation: 包括男人、女人、老人和小孩。
questions.explanation: men（男人）与women（女人）相对，the old（老人）与the young（年轻人/小孩）相对，成对并列。故选 women。

questions.translation: 他们通常和我们合影拍照。
questions.explanation: take photos with sb.为固定短语，意为“和某人合影拍照”。故选 photos。

questions.translation: 然后我们吃早餐。
questions.explanation: have breakfast为固定搭配，意为“吃早餐”。故选 have。

questions.translation: 竹子是我们最喜爱的食物。
questions.explanation: 竹子（bamboo）是熊猫的食物（food）。故选 food。

questions.translation: 我们的饲养员对我们很友善。
questions.explanation: be kind to sb.为固定短语，意为“对某人友好/亲切”。故选 kind。

questions.translation: 我经常和我弟弟一起玩耍。
questions.explanation: play with sb.为固定短语，意为“和某人一起玩”。故选 play。

questions.translation: 欢迎来到我们的动物园。
questions.explanation: 根据前一句“We like our zoo very much.”可知大熊猫生活在动物园（zoo）。故选 zoo。

sections.title: 九、真题演练 (阅读理解)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列关于急救 AED 使用说明，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
# How to Use an AED (自动体外除颤器)

When someone's heart suddenly stops, we can use an AED to save him or her. It can be found in public places and it is easy to use. Turn it on and follow the voice instructions. Here are some key steps.

1. Place one pad onto the upper-right chest (胸膛). Place the other onto the lower-left chest.
2. Connect the pads to the AED.
3. Don't touch the patient! Wait for the result of the examination.
4. Press the button when a shock is advised.
5. Give CPR (心肺复苏) if needed.

**Remember:** It's best to treat the patient within the "Golden 4 Minutes"! Time matters! If an AED is not around, send someone to get one and give CPR while waiting. Don't forget to call 120.

questions.prompt: 1. When is an AED used?
questions.translation: AED在什么时候被使用？
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“When someone's heart suddenly stops, we can use an AED to save him or her.”可知，在某人心脏骤停时使用。故选 When someone's heart suddenly stops.。

questions.prompt: 2. Where should the pads be placed on the patient?
options: One onto the upper-right chest, the other onto the lower-left chest.
Both pads onto the center of the abdomen.
One onto the left shoulder, the other onto the right knee.
Both pads onto the lower-right chest.
questions.translation: 电极贴片应该贴在患者的什么位置？
questions.explanation: 根据步骤1“Place one pad onto the upper-right chest. Place the other onto the lower-left chest.”可知，一片贴在右上胸，另一片贴在左下胸。故选 One onto the upper-right chest, the other onto the lower-left chest.。

questions.prompt: 3. What's the golden time to use an AED?
questions.translation: 使用AED的黄金时间是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文末“It's best to treat the patient within the 'Golden 4 Minutes'!”可知黄金抢救时间是前4分钟。故选 The first 4 minutes.。
